name: Super Smash Bros. Crusade Remix
summary: Super Smash Bros. Crusade Remix is the strange child of Crusade and CMC+ put into one package - retaining the fundamentals, fun and style of Crusade (Albiet, with their old-school philosophies), and the content and customisability of CMC+. The intent was to sort of run with an old-school vison of what the game would look like with lessened pressure, and a stronger focus on shaking things up rather than replicating Ultimate and seeing what sticks.
